sample_unit: digitized H&E-stained oral mucosal images (100 OPMD; 100 normal)

links.outcome: Inter-run reproducibility of binary diagnostic outputs across repeated runs
links.effect: Binary outputs demonstrated high inter-run stability (Fleiss' κ = 0.82).
links.quote: Binary outputs demonstrated high inter-run stability (Fleiss' κ = 0.82).

links.outcome: Model diagnostic performance versus expert consensus across abstraction levels
links.effect: Sensitivity 87.0% and specificity 89.0%; agreement declined from κ 0.85 (coarse) to 0.42 (architectural) to 0.09 (high-risk cytologic); grading weighted κ 0.36 with under-grading.
links.quote: Agreement declined monotonically across morphologic abstraction domains (κ: 0.85 coarse morphology; 0.42 architectural; 0.09 high-risk cytologic; P[ordered] ≈ 1.000).

screen.reason: This is a retrospective diagnostic benchmark evaluating the accuracy, grading reliability, and error patterns of a multimodal foundation model on oral histopathology images without evaluating a specific implementation guardrail or deployment practice.
